text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads up — City LLM Night is 3 weeks out (Thu 4/9). We got a mini booth (6x6) and a speaking slot (20m + Q&A). Need quick checklist: swag qty, banner, monitor, volunteer shifts, slide deadline. Who can take point on logistics?

Leo (Events): I got booth specs from venue: 6x6 table, single 2A outlet, no power strip on request. Backdrop allowed up to 8ft. Monitor stand ok. Delivery window: 4/8 9am-11am only.

Priya (Demand Gen): Speaker slot confirmed — Priya's talk "Serving LLMs at low cost" accepted. Slides due EOD 4/2. Can we get a 1-slide TL;DR and 3 bullets for the booth script by 4/1? I can draft messaging but need product line: hosted vs dedicated differentiation.

Noah (Ops): Swag vendor ETA: GoodShip. My proposed order: 400 stickers, 200 tees (mixed sizes), 150 postcards (promo code), 50 enamel pins. Lead magnets: 150 demo cards with QR. Shipping cutoff: send to venue by 4/6 to avoid issues. Budget OK?

Ava (Marketing): Budget signed off. Reduce tees to 150 if cost spike. Prioritize stickers + demo cards. :thumbsup:

Sam (Field): Lead routing plan: scan QR -> capture email + company + interest (hosted/dedicated/private). Assign leads by company size: <10k MAU -> Field (me), 10k-100k -> Account Execs, >100k -> Sales Eng. Add tags: event:uptown-llm-night, interest:{hosted,dedicated,private}. I'll create Airtable view and webhook.

Priya (Demand Gen): Messaging draft for booth (short):
- Line 1 (hook): "Make LLM inference predictable — lower cost, fewer surprises."
- Line 2 (what we do): "Unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, private deployments."
- CTA: "Scan for a short demo + $500 credit"
Can you folks sanity check?

Leo (Events): Banner size rec: 33x80in vertical. I'll order a lightweight roller. We have 1 monitor mount in inventory (AV#23) but need HDMI splitter and a small laptop. Volunteer schedule: 2 people on shift: 5:30-7, 7-8:30. Can Ava and Sam cover nights?

Ava (Marketing): I can do 5:30-7. Sam can take second shift. I'll coordinate volunteers.

Noah (Ops): Shipping packing list (copy/paste for GoodShip):
```
To: Venue Receiving
Company: Redwood Inference / Booth 12
Delivery window: 2026-04-08 09:00-11:00
Items:
- 1x roller banner (33x80)
- 1x monitor + mount (AV#23)
- 150 tees (mixed sizes)
- 400 stickers (rolls)
- 150 postcards + 150 demo cards w/ QR
- 50 enamel pins
- 1x laptop (MacBook Air) + 1x HDMI splitter
- Printed name badges (6)
Contact on delivery: Leo (phone XXX-XXX-XXXX)
```

swag-bot: Order confirmation received: GoodShip order GS-993 created 2026-03-22. Est. ship 2026-04-04. Tracking TBD.

Priya (Demand Gen): Quick ask — can we make the QR landing page capture model preferences (embedding vs generation) and a tiny eval prompt? That helps us route to the right demo. Sam — can you add fields?

Sam (Field): Yep, I'll add two dropdowns: company_size, interest_product, and a 1-sentence prompt. Then webhook -> Airtable. Sharing view soon: https://airtable.com/shrExampleView (will replace with real link).

Leo (Events): Volunteers: Ava (5:30-7), Sam (7-8:30). Need one more person for 5:30-8:30 split. Anyone from Eng nearby?

Ava (Marketing): @Oliver from SDK said he'd come if schedule allows. I'll ping him.

Priya (Demand Gen): Slide checklist for speaker: 1) 3-min TL;DR slide, 2) architecture diagram (1 slide), 3) demo screenshots (2 slides), 4) CTA + credit slide. Submit PDF by 4/2 EOD.

Noah (Ops): Reminder: insurance proof required by venue by 4/3. I'll upload cert to the shared folder. Also forwarding the loading dock map now.

Ava (Marketing): Final tasks & owners:
- Banner & monitor logistics: Leo
- Swag order + packing list: Noah
- Speaker slides + booth script: Priya
- Lead routing + Airtable: Sam
- Volunteer confirmations: Ava
Please update the checklist sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/0example (edit access for marketing+events).

Sam (Field): I'll set automation to tag leads and send a follow-up email template that includes the $500 credit code. Template draft in sheet.

Leo (Events): Postmortem note: set alarm for early delivery on 4/8. Venue is strict on timing.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team — let's run a dry-run next Tue 3/30 at 11am (15m). I'll put calendar invite. :raised_hands:
